_doc: Arena hazards a mutator switches on ("hazards": [ids] in data/rules/mutators.json; read by Hazards in src/sim/hazards.gd, keys in docs/MECHANICS.md "Arena hazards"). Each has a shape (wave: a front that sweeps the floor from one seeded edge; meteors: a shower of falling rocks, each a growing shadow first; boulder: count lanes across the floor warn at once (from different edges in the order of sides, so they cross), then a boulder rolls down each; boulders that touch ricochet off each other (an equal-weight bounce, ricochet_speed_mult slower, never under min_speed, the pair not again for ricochet_cooldown_ticks), a wall or fence bounces one wall_bounces times before it shatters, a pit swallows it, the floor's edge ends it; a strike of a reverse_types move (a heavy) sends one back at the others, reverse_max times a roll, reverse_speed_mult faster; preview_ticks is how long the views show a turned boulder's new way; fault: a seeded line cracks, then opens into a chasm strip width cells wide for open_seconds and closes back to the map), a schedule (first_seconds: when the first warning starts, every_seconds: from one warning to the next, warn_seconds or warn_ticks: how long the warning shows) and effects: damage_pct (true damage, a share of max HP, ignores guard and shields), role_mult (per sheet role), min_hp (it never takes anyone below this: 1 means it can't KO), push (px a tick, divided by weight), stun (ticks of hitstun with the push), knockdown (ticks of a knockdown with the push instead), crack / pit / pit_core (floor damage where it strikes), shallows (cells turn to shallows for a while, then back to the map), pickup (left on the floor: the first fighter to touch it takes the buff). name and desc are for the menu (Single player > Arena > Arena options: one On/Off row per hazard).

tidal_wave.name: Tidal wave
tidal_wave.desc: A wave sweeps the floor from a random edge: it hurts and shoves you downstream unless you hide behind rubble

meteor_shower.name: Meteor shower
meteor_shower.desc: Meteors fall in showers: step out of the growing shadows; one leaves a core that powers you up

rolling_boulder.name: Rolling boulder
rolling_boulder.desc: Boulders roll down marked lanes and bounce off each other and the walls: step out of their way, or hit one with a heavy to send it back

fault_line.name: Fault line
fault_line.desc: The ground cracks along a line, then splits into a chasm for a while: get off the crack before it opens
